integrity: Universal statements rest on a self-contained proof; finite computations corroborate selected parameters. Published affine-subspace online rank and classical affine-matroid independence counts are acknowledged as prior phenomena.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the full family of exact-rank affine flats over finite fields. It does not classify arbitrary subfamilies, unions, projective flats or all mixed-label conditional residual classes. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Fixed-rank affine-flat shattering complexes over finite fields
